decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin builds directly on the firm's plugin development and analytics know-how, and GA4 remains Google's mandatory standard, so shop clients will keep needing it.
Universal Analytics has been fully shut down by Google, so the plugin is obsolete and the firm's analytics knowledge is better applied to the GA4 successor.
The retail system interface plugin draws on the firm's core interface competence and supports ongoing client integrations whose results the firm can interpret and improve.
Relaunch SEO support combines the firm's proven relaunch project experience with its search marketing expertise, and its own page signals continued strategic commitment.
The SEO workshops turn the firm's established search marketing knowledge into a low-cost advisory format with its own page, and they strengthen client relationships for other services.
